title: CAPED: Context-Aware Privacy Exposure Defense for Mobile GUI Agents
title_zh: CAPED：面向移动 GUI Agent 的上下文感知隐私暴露防御
abstract_en: Screenshot-based mobile GUI agents can operate ordinary smartphone apps through the same visual interface as a human user, but this capability also turns every screen observation into a privacy boundary. During normal task execution, screenshots may expose contacts, messages, photos, files, recommendations, health cues, and other sensitive context that is unrelated to the user's request. We call this problem incidental visual privacy exposure. It is difficult to address with existing defenses: text anonymization misses many visual and inferential cues, while generic privacy masking can remove the evidence and controls that a GUI agent needs to complete the task. This paper presents CAPED, a context-aware pre-upload exposure control layer for mobile GUI agents. CAPED is designed as a phone-side protection layer: before screenshots are released to a remote multimodal agent, it extracts task requirements, uses screen context as a privacy prior, parses visible UI elements, and selectively exposes only content needed for the current task while masking incidental private content. We evaluate CAPED on AndroidWorld for broad task utility and with a controlled 28-task seeded privacy evaluation used as a measurement instrument for trajectory-level incidental leakage. In this seeded evaluation, Full CAPED reduces success-conditioned weighted seeded leakage from 0.766 under raw screenshots to 0.268 while preserving high task utility. A broader AndroidWorld run shows a remaining prototype-level utility cost, but the results support the central claim that screenshot upload should be treated as an explicit device--cloud boundary decision, governed by task-driven selective exposure rather than all-or-nothing screen sharing.
abstract_zh: 基于截图的移动 GUI Agent 能像人类用户一样通过视觉界面操作普通智能手机应用，但这也使每一次屏幕观测都成为潜在的隐私边界。在正常任务执行中，截图可能暴露联系人、消息、照片、文件、推荐内容、健康线索等与用户请求无关的敏感上下文。论文将这一问题称为“偶发视觉隐私暴露”（incidental visual privacy exposure）。现有防御难以有效处理：文本匿名化会遗漏大量视觉和推理线索，而通用隐私遮罩又可能移除 GUI Agent 完成任务所需的证据和控件。为此，论文提出 CAPED，一个面向移动 GUI Agent 的上下文感知、上传前隐私暴露控制层。CAPED 在手机端运行：在截图发送给远程多模态 Agent 前，提取任务需求，将屏幕上下文作为隐私先验，解析可见 UI 元素，并仅选择性暴露当前任务所需内容，同时遮蔽偶发私人信息。作者在 AndroidWorld 上评估通用任务效用，并构建包含 28 个任务的受控种子隐私评测，用于衡量轨迹级偶发泄漏。在该评测中，Full CAPED 将成功条件下的加权种子泄漏从原始截图的 0.766 降至 0.268，同时保持较高任务效用。更大规模 AndroidWorld 实验显示原型系统仍存在一定效用代价，但结果支持其核心主张：截图上传应被视为明确的端云边界决策，并由任务驱动的选择性暴露机制治理，而非简单的全屏共享或完全屏蔽。
key_points_zh: 提出“偶发视觉隐私暴露”问题：移动 GUI Agent 在执行正常任务时，截图可能泄露与任务无关的联系人、消息、照片、健康线索等敏感信息。
CAPED 是手机端的 pre-upload 防护层，在截图上传至远程多模态 Agent 前，结合任务需求、屏幕上下文隐私先验和 UI 元素解析进行选择性暴露。
相比文本匿名化或通用遮罩，CAPED 的目标是在保留任务所需证据与控件的同时，遮蔽无关私人内容，避免过度泄露或过度遮挡。
在 28-task seeded privacy evaluation 中，Full CAPED 将成功条件下的加权种子泄漏从 raw screenshots 的 0.766 降至 0.268，并保持较高任务效用。
AndroidWorld 更广泛评测表明当前原型仍有一定 utility cost，但验证了截图上传应作为 device-cloud boundary decision，由任务驱动的选择性暴露控制。

llm_assessment.comment: A practically important privacy layer for screenshot-based GUI agents that addresses a real deployment bottleneck despite limited realtime or speech-agent relevance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项面向截图式 GUI 智能体的实用隐私防护工作，解决了真实部署瓶颈，但与实时或语音智能体关联较弱。
